name: Step into your drawing
summary:
Every child's drawing is a world. Now you can step into it.

It starts on paper: your child draws with pencils, markers or crayons. When the drawing is finished, take a photo with your phone. Step into your drawing turns it into a world you can walk around in on Meta Quest. Not a template, but the drawing itself: your child's lines, colors and characters stay recognizably theirs — all around you.

• Made from a real drawing on paper
• Each world can come with a short story about the drawing
• Comfortable: t
